row.body: The town map is folded around a gate key; the population sheet says the district was cleared before the last road check.
row.title: Town boundary map

sidecar.gloss: A district is marked clear before its last road check.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field survey could clear a district for routine work; the sheet does not say who made the call.

row.body: the fire extinguisher and camera are wrapped in a child's raincoat. one stayed dry while the other was left in road mud.
row.title: missing count beside the fire extinguisher

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
